name: auto-bump-version-on-done-merge
title: Auto-bump patch version on DONE merge to local main (sync 3 version points)
description: When a story DONE-merges to local main with material code changes, automatically increment the patch version across all three sync points (root package.json, packages/main/package.json, lattice-brand.ts LATTICE_CLI_VERSION) so releasing is turnkey and the three points never drift. Operator hit this gap on B-5d18 (had to manually bump to 0.3.9). Reuse the existing DONE post-merge effect that already runs under the main write-lock and already rebuilds dist.
